final: WITH g AS (SELECT P.ID AS id, P.SEX AS sex, AVG(L.PLT) AS avg_plt FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_plt) AS overall FROM g), d AS (SELECT g.id, g.sex, g.avg_plt, g.avg_plt - o.overall AS diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL), s AS (SELECT sex, AVG(diff) AS sex_avg FROM d GROUP BY sex), k AS (SELECT d.avg_plt, d.diff, d.diff - s.sex_avg AS diff2 FROM d JOIN s ON d.sex = s.sex WHERE d.diff > s.sex_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_plt) AS avg_group_plt, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff, AVG(diff2) AS avg_diff_minus_sex_avg FROM k
